title: Data Management Plans (DMPs)
description: Approved and in-progress Data Management Plans (DMPs) exported from the TU/e Research Cockpit. One row per DMP ticket. Reporting period: DMPs created on or after 2025-09-01.

fields.name: issue_key
fields.title: Issue key
fields.description: Unique DMP ticket identifier (e.g. DMP-1326).

fields.name: issue_title
fields.title: Issue title
fields.description: Title of the DMP / research project.

fields.name: issue_creation_time
fields.title: Issue creation time
fields.description: When the DMP ticket was created (ISO 8601, UTC).

fields.name: is_approved
fields.title: Is approved
fields.description: Whether the DMP is currently in an approved state.

fields.name: latest_status_time
fields.title: Latest status time
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent status transition.

fields.name: status_history
fields.title: Status history
fields.description: Full chronological status history as a JSON array of {status, timestamp} objects.

fields.name: ordered_status_transition_list
fields.title: Ordered status transitions
fields.description: Ordered list of status transitions (status names only), most-recent first.

fields.name: days_to_first_approval
fields.title: Days to first approval
fields.description: Days from DMP creation to first approval.

fields.name: tue_department
fields.title: TU/e department
fields.description: TU/e department(s) associated with the project; comma-separated when multiple.

fields.name: data_volume_list
fields.title: Data volume (bucket)
fields.description: Coarse data-volume bucket.

fields.name: data_volume_tb
fields.title: Data volume (TB)
fields.description: Estimated data volume in terabytes.

fields.name: has_data_volume_info
fields.title: Has data volume info
fields.description: Whether data-volume information was provided.

fields.name: data_storage_list
fields.title: Data storage list
fields.description: JSON array of storage solutions listed in the DMP.

fields.name: data_storage_after_list
fields.title: Data storage (after) list
fields.description: JSON array of storage solutions to be used after the project ends.

fields.name: has_data_storage_info
fields.title: Has data storage info
fields.description: Whether storage information was provided.

fields.name: storage_solution_count
fields.title: Storage solution count
fields.description: Number of storage solutions listed.

fields.name: data_repository
fields.title: Data repository
fields.description: JSON array of repositories selected for data publication (e.g. 4TU.ResearchData, Zenodo, OSF, 'I need advice').

fields.name: metadata_standard
fields.title: Metadata standard
fields.description: Selected metadata standard(s); comma-separated (not a JSON array).

fields.name: processing_tools_list
fields.title: Processing tools list
fields.description: JSON array of data processing tools.

fields.name: processing_tools_count
fields.title: Processing tools count
fields.description: Number of processing tools listed.

fields.name: processing_tools_info
fields.title: Has processing tools info
fields.description: Whether processing-tools information was provided.

fields.name: related_erb
fields.title: Related ERB
fields.description: Issue key of the linked ERB (foreign key to ERBs.issue_key).

fields.name: erb_link_creation_date
fields.title: ERB link creation date
fields.description: When the ERB link was created.

fields.name: has_related_erb
fields.title: Has related ERB
fields.description: Whether an ERB is linked to this DMP.

fields.name: days_to_erb_link_creation
fields.title: Days to ERB link creation
fields.description: Days from DMP creation to ERB link creation.

fields.name: ever_approved
fields.title: Ever approved
fields.description: Whether the DMP was ever approved at any point in its history.

fields.name: approval_count
fields.title: Approval count
fields.description: Number of times the DMP was approved.

fields.name: gold_processed_at
fields.title: Gold processed at
fields.description: When the record was processed into the gold fact table.

fields.name: is_scientific
fields.title: Is scientific purpose
fields.description: Whether the project is for a scientific purpose (false = educational; missing = unknown).

fields.name: has_special_category
fields.title: Has special category
fields.description: Whether the project involves special-category (sensitive) data.

fields.name: data_sharing
fields.title: Data sharing
fields.description: Whether data is shared outside TU/e and the destination.

fields.name: archive_location
fields.title: Archive location
fields.description: Where project data is archived.
